Placements & Careers

Your next step in healthcare starts with the right guidance

For Students

Placements & CareersStudent SupportAlumniNotices & EventsContact Us

From learning to professional practice

Graduation opens different doors for doctors, dentists and nurses. Whether you are considering clinical work, further study, teaching or research, use this page to explore the next step and reach the right college team.

Career pathways

Medical College

Explore clinical practice, postgraduate study, medical education, public health and research. For internship postings and completion requirements, contact the Medical College office.

Speak to the Medical College →

Dental College

Explore dental practice, postgraduate specialisation, teaching, research and community oral health. Contact the Dental College for internship and career-related enquiries.

Speak to the Dental College →

Nursing College

Explore hospital nursing, community healthcare, nursing education, further study and specialist practice. Contact the Nursing College for guidance relevant to your programme.

Speak to the Nursing College →

Internships & opportunities

For current recruitment notices, career events or internship information, check the notices page or contact your college office. Availability and application requirements depend on the opportunity.

View notices & updates →

Stay connected with SVS

Hear from the alumni community and share where your own career has taken you.

Meet our alumni →

Career & recruitment enquiries

Students and healthcare employers can contact the college office to be connected with the appropriate team.
